verdict.rationale: The GrowthBook Proxy is documented as enabling "real-time feature rollouts" and caching SDK payloads, and SDKs fetch flag definitions from an SDK Connection Endpoint and evaluate them locally. That supports fast propagation, but the real-time claim is tied to running the Proxy, and the evidence never describes the streaming or polling mechanism or how quickly a kill switch takes effect. Missing for 10: explicit docs on SDK streaming/SSE or polling intervals, a stated propagation latency (seconds), confirmation that real-time updates work without the self-hosted Proxy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a kill switch takes effect quickly.
